record.title: One hundred rotating Buddha heads
record.dek: A monochrome image-model cue deck: postal skate-zine Buddhas, ocean Buddhas, city Buddhas, mountain Buddhas, stamp sheets, meditating heads, and empty-business-room apparitions with meditative audio options.
record.body: A rotating visual block for PointCast: one hundred Buddha-head directions arranged as a living image-model deck. The first run starts in a skate-magazine paste-up register near post offices and mailboxes, then moves through monochrome 80s, 70s, 60s, ancient, ocean, De Stijl grid, silkscreen pop, stamp-sheet, meditating, midcentury art-deco business interiors, New York City subway, Tokyo rain, mountain sculpture, and ten more environment families. Each direction carries digital tinting, audio modes, and the signature line: Michael Hoydich.
record.author: mh+cc
